verdict.rationale: Jan is itself an AI assistant and agent client (an open-source ChatGPT replacement that runs autonomous agents), so serving an official MCP server for other agents is a different product role. Its MCP evidence is client-side: it connects to MCP servers and asks for tool-call approval. The 'Jan Browser MCP' changelog entry describes a browser-automation tool Jan uses, not Jan exposing itself as an MCP server to outside agents. There is no evidence of an 'mcp serve' mode or a first-party hosted MCP endpoint.
